paper_metadata.title: Structure, mechanical properties, and oxidation behaviour of refractory NbTiZrM (M = Ta, Mo, V) complex concentrated alloys

evidence.quote: In this study, we systematically explored the effect of Ta, Mo, and V on the structure, mechanical properties, and oxidation behaviour of a single-phase body-centred cubic (bcc) NbTiZr alloy.
